pedestrian_signals.assumption: Modelled pedestrian poles are fixed beside the crossing approaches: 3 m perpendicular to the crossing line and 5 m back from each end, away from the crossing interior. They do not follow the walker. The source endpoint height is retained at the offset location (local level-ground display assumption). These are illustrative roadside positions, not surveyed hardware or verified kerbs. Heads are 0.60 m wide by 1.20 m high, with the bottom 2.10 m above that ground estimate. Ordinary heads shrink with distance. Only the current crossing receives an enlarged inspection highlight; its pixel size is not a physical dimension. Source trajectories, crossing times and health results are unchanged.
